# Daniel Suarez — full profile

> CTO / Sr. Software Engineer at Aloharmony, a wellness app with therapeutic music (~52k users, iOS, Android, web). Based in Buenos Aires, Argentina (UTC-3). His value is knowing WHAT to ask AI and HOW: broad, hands-on knowledge lets him direct a governed team of AI agents with judgment and turn it into results.

## Summary

Daniel Suarez has 6 years of experience designing and shipping web and mobile products across the full stack: mobile apps, web platforms, backend APIs, data, payments and cloud infrastructure. As CTO of Aloharmony he owns the full product ecosystem and runs it with a team of ~10 AI agents. He also founded DesitionDev, the public home of his own products built by Desition Labs.

## Core message

AI multiplies whoever directs it. Daniel's edge is not "using AI", it is knowing what to ask and how to ask it — and recognizing when an answer is wrong. Generalist depth across product, engineering, infrastructure, data, design and growth is what makes that judgment possible.

## AI working method

- A team of ~10 AI agents covering development, QA, project management, product ownership, UX, marketing, support and finance.
- Agents work 24/7 across the whole platform.
- Governance:
  - Human approval: nothing is published, spent or deleted without Daniel's explicit sign-off.
  - Mandatory QA with evidence before anything ships.
  - Security review for sensitive changes.
  - Automated test suites gate every release.

## Aloharmony — results 2024–2026

- Store-compliant monetization: split purchase flows between the new web app and a store-compliant payment gateway.
- Free trial launched end-to-end.
- New web app designed and shipped end-to-end.
- Migrated a GraphQL-federation microservices backend to an optimized monolith (lower latency, less operational complexity).
- Partner integrations.
- App v4 and v5, plus a visual redesign of the web, landing, account area and blog.
- SEO and GEO (generative engine optimization).
- New in-house API and CRM.
- Metabase analytics, an events system on Kafka, and content management.
- AI image generation grounded in the design system.
- Subscriptions with RevenueCat.
- Landing load time cut from ~3s to ~200ms with Next.js SSR and CloudFront.

## Previous experience

- Technical Leader, CRIZZ (Colombia, remote), Jun 2022 – Dec 2023: led a team of 5 developers across Subliful, Adkiero, Yovoto and XProfit; defined stacks and architecture; set code review and sprint practices; mentored engineers.
- Full Stack Developer, Thought Media (USA, remote), Jan 2021 – Jan 2022: e-commerce with PayPal and Authorize.net; shipped the TaxMambo React Native app.

## Skills

- Technical: React, Next.js, Astro, TailwindCSS, React Native, Expo, Zustand, Node.js, NestJS, GraphQL, REST, gRPC, AWS (ECS, EC2, S3, CloudFront, Route53), Docker, Redis, BigQuery, Kafka, Metabase, Stripe, PayPal, Authorize.net, RevenueCat, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD.
- Leadership and soft skills: technical leadership, mentoring, translating business goals into technical plans, stakeholder communication, prioritization.
- Generalist: product, design systems, SEO/GEO, analytics, monetization, AI orchestration.
- Languages: Spanish (native), English (advanced).
- Education: CS50 Introduction to Computer Science (HarvardX).

## FAQ

Q: Who is Daniel Suarez?
A: A CTO / Sr. Software Engineer in Buenos Aires who leads technology at Aloharmony (~52k users on iOS, Android and web) and founded DesitionDev.

Q: What makes him different?
A: He knows what to ask AI and how. Broad, hands-on knowledge lets him direct a team of AI agents with judgment and catch wrong output.

Q: How does he work with AI agents?
A: ~10 agents (dev, QA, PM, PO, UX, marketing, support, finance) work 24/7 under human approval to publish, spend or delete; mandatory QA with evidence; security review; and automated tests.

Q: Is he available?
A: Open for consulting and select project work. Contact: info@desitiondev.com.
